title: Accounting Agents research corpus
mission: A public, read-only research corpus that helps people and agents find, understand, and reuse the information needed to build accounting agents.
coverage_note: Final corrected US nonprofit delivery supplement 2026-09-17.1: 1,072 records and 179 named questions; the existing 96 subsector profiles, 5,952 applicability screenings and 1,012 individual industry exception reviews remain. The supplement adds a qualified nongovernmental US nonprofit contribution/restriction guide and original worked example, not a complete nonprofit package. Named answers remain partial or evidence gaps; no whole question family, subsector or detailed industry is assessed sufficient. Existing international material is retained without substituting it for US authority.
review_note: All 715 inherited records have documented dispositions. The 488 source reviews comprise 239 substantive-excerpt checks, 199 abstract or landing-page checks and 50 unresolved access attempts. These are scoped AI-assisted checks, not full-text or professional verification. Applicability, accounting adequacy, source currency, professional review, empirical support and reuse rights remain independent. Construction supplement dated 2026-09-14 rechecks selected public authority and adds original correction/cutoff branches and GAO aggregate observations; no actual ledger validation or professional sign-off. Four-gap follow-through adds selected same-job adjudicated facts and an access-only Codification check; none of the four external evidence gaps is marked closed. Local consistency edition 2026-09-14.3 completes the selected qualified construction reading path without closing those external gaps. Final corrected US nonprofit supplement 2026-09-17.1 preserves the two FASB source checks and one IRS Form 990 instruction check recorded in their provenance, adds structured source periods and locators plus a dated synthetic close rollforward, and preserves the outgoing 2026-09-16.1 artifact as an immutable historical release. It does not assert a new review of current consolidated Codification, professional sign-off, endowment/contributed-services completion or operational validation. The 31-issue backlog remains open; publishing this batch is not acceptance of every ticket.
rights_note: Project-created factual metadata is CC0 1.0. Original editorial content is CC BY 4.0. Software is MIT. External source content is not redistributed or licensed by this project; access is not permission for training or reuse.
coverage_priorities: Reverify inherited source URLs, editions, effective dates, supersession, and evidence classifications; keep release-specific checks current.
Add jurisdiction-specific accounting, audit, tax, payroll, and public-sector authorities beyond the present US, European and selected other coverage.
Deepen real transaction-level and ledger evidence, finance-specific CDC/deletion behavior, ERP completeness and reconciliation examples; documented contracts remain untested here.
Add independent empirical deployment studies, incident and failure reports, and reproducible accounting workflow evidence beyond controlled questions and synthetic datasets.
Resolve dataset-specific and upstream permissions, including TabFormer and the FiFAR/BAF interaction; keep unknown rights unknown.

Deepen construction coverage with current consolidated GAAP review, state-specific tax and public-works rules, contract and job-cost datasets, ERP lineage and professional validation; continue other industry guidance including nonprofit and government implementation.
